match_events_minute_range.name: match_events_minute_range
match_events_minute_range.value: minute IS NULL OR (minute BETWEEN 0 AND 150)

match_events_added_time_range.name: match_events_added_time_range
match_events_added_time_range.value: added_time IS NULL OR (added_time BETWEEN 0 AND 30)

matches_scores_non_negative.name: matches_scores_non_negative
matches_scores_non_negative.value:
(home_score_ft IS NULL OR home_score_ft >= 0)
          AND (away_score_ft IS NULL OR away_score_ft >= 0)
          AND (home_score_ht IS NULL OR home_score_ht >= 0)
          AND (away_score_ht IS NULL OR away_score_ht >= 0)

players_shirt_number_range.name: players_shirt_number_range
players_shirt_number_range.value: shirt_number IS NULL OR (shirt_number BETWEEN 0 AND 99)

players_height_range.name: players_height_range
players_height_range.value: height_cm IS NULL OR (height_cm BETWEEN 120 AND 230)

push_subscriptions_quiet_hours_range.name: push_subscriptions_quiet_hours_range
push_subscriptions_quiet_hours_range.value:
(quiet_start_hour IS NULL OR quiet_start_hour BETWEEN 0 AND 23)
          AND (quiet_end_hour IS NULL OR quiet_end_hour BETWEEN 0 AND 23)

seasons_dates_ordered.name: seasons_dates_ordered
seasons_dates_ordered.value: start_date IS NULL OR end_date IS NULL OR start_date <= end_date
